chronicle.text: Geiyes found that what Suti had told them was wrong, and trusted them less for it.
Nebu tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Kivuvoum gathered food that had grown where seeds had been dropped: the first harvest from seed left in the ground.
Tuyanei scratched a mark <-|^> into the ground.
Sukeimo went back to a thing they had made a third time, to see it happen again: the first deliberate testing.
Geiyes told Suti that Timaiyos could be believed: reputation passed on by word.
Thuvuneim tied a carrier and wood together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
Tuyanei tied a stone flake and wood together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
Kivuvoum buried seed on purpose, having seen it come back as food: the beginning of farming.
Thuvuneim crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
Someis drank from the sea and it did not quench their thirst.
Thuvuneim struck flint with flint and stared at what happened.
Thuvuneim struck flint with flint and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
Thuvuneim tied a carrier and a blade together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
Gozi struck flint where dry things lay, and they caught: the first fire made by people.
Beseiyu attacked Nishei: the first violence.
Kivuvoum crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
Someis crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
Gozi came back for food left 26 weeks before, and it was still there.
Gozi set food aside on purpose, having found it there when it was needed before: the beginning of keeping stores.
Nishei took in the orphan Detoubum, no relation, the first time a stranger raised another's child.
Detoubum tied a club and a club together with fiber and was left with something warm to wear: the first wrap.
3 people now take the mark <o^|> to go with seed sown in autumn, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
At (15, 21) the heap of things people had left grew big enough to keep out a fifth of the winter cold: the first dwelling. Tesek had put in the most.
A thirsty year: 3 people died for want of water.
Youzoun took up striking stone with flint from a mark: the first thing learned from a record.
Youzoun came on the mark <-//> and took it to mean stone being struck: the first mark read as a message.
Tusal found that what the mark <^^.> seemed to say was wrong, and put less faith in that mark.
4 people now take the mark <-//> to go with rabbits, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
The mark <o^|> has drifted: it went with seed sown in autumn, and now, for 3 people, with Nitous.
3 people now take the mark <..\> to go with stone being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Someis crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
3 people now take the mark </v^> to go with deer, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
4 people now take the mark <./\> to go with growing food, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
3 people now take the mark <\|/> to go with seed sown in winter, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
4 people now take the mark <o^v> to go with seed sown in winter, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.

Years 0-24: population 20 to 16, 14 births. Deaths mostly from starvation (6), illness (5), thirst (5). Average happiness 0.74. Recorded: 6 inventions, 21 firsts, 14 band changes, 6 new exchange partnerships, 3 new settlements.
7 people now take the mark <^o/> to go with rabbits, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
5 people now take the mark <\o-> to go with shelter, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
3 people now take the mark <v|/> to go with rabbits, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
The mark <./\> has drifted: it went with growing food, and now, for 3 people, with seed sown in winter.
5 people now take the mark <\|v> to go with seed sown in autumn, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
The mark <\|/> has drifted: it went with seed sown in winter, and now, for 6 people, with rabbits.
The mark <\|v> has drifted: it went with seed sown in autumn, and now, for 8 people, with rabbits.
The mark <\|v> has drifted: it went with rabbits, and now, for 7 people, with shelter.
6 people now take the mark <^\/> to go with a grave, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
9 people now take the mark <^^.> to go with food set down, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
10 people now take the mark <^^/> to go with wood being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
The mark <^\/> has drifted: it went with a grave, and now, for 8 people, with shelter.
The mark <^^/> has drifted: it went with wood being struck, and now, for 8 people, with shelter.

Years 25-49: population 16 to 13, 7 births. Deaths mostly from illness (7), old age (2), starvation (1). Average happiness 0.72. Recorded: 1 band changes, 1 new exchange partnerships, 2 new settlements.
4 people now take the mark </\^> to go with shelter, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Years 50-74: population 13 to 8, 1 births. Deaths mostly from old age (3), illness (2), starvation (1). Average happiness 0.69. A quiet age.
Years 75-99: population 8 to 1, 0 births. Deaths mostly from old age (4), illness (2), starvation (1). Average happiness 0.60. Recorded: 1 band changes.
